name: bold experience claim into a fader control demo
looks: A big bold number and a short claim about years of experience hold on a flat colour card, then cut to a row of four vertical sliders, each labelled for a different part of the process, their handles animating up and down to different heights at different times, as if someone were mixing a board live.
build: The number card is flat DOM type on a solid field; the fader demo uses the fader-level-set mechanic, DOM tracks with handles tweening to target positions on staggered beats (power2.out, 0.3-0.4 s).
sound: A low confident hit under the number card, then a soft mechanical slide per handle with a faint click as each settles.
prompt: Hold a bold number and a short claim of hard-won experience on a flat colour card, then cut to a row of vertical sliders, one per part of the process, each moving to a different height at a different moment rather than all together, so the shot reads as someone actively mixing the levers rather than leaving them on a default.
